summary: Frontend preview and camera-start flow tested at 390x844. Home screen loads, but MediaPipe runtime bundling fails when camera is started, so real detection and calibration cannot run.

integration_issues.issue: Metro fails transforming @mediapipe/tasks-vision/vision_bundle.mjs with Invalid call at import(t.toString()); engine never reaches running state, FPS stays 0.0 and real metrics/calibration samples never arrive.
The UI advances to calibration with streamRef null and only shows a generic notice; calibration remains locked forever because no engine error/progress state is surfaced.

action_items: Fix Expo Metro compatibility with @mediapipe/tasks-vision 1.0.1 dynamic import so the web bundle can load the real FaceLandmarker; verify engine loading/running/error transitions.
Handle denied/unavailable camera as an explicit error state or prevent entering calibration; do not leave the primary button permanently locked.
critical_code_review_comments: Demo renders 18 deterministic decorative landmark dots even when no face has been detected; this can visually imply fabricated detection and conflicts with the no-fabricated-data requirement. Render overlays only from actual landmarks.
PRD backlog still lists FaceLandmarker integration as pending despite the implementation being present; update documentation after the bundling issue is resolved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: At 390x844, home loads successfully. Clicking data-testid=button-Iniciar Demonstração reaches calibration, but console shows vision_bundle.mjs Invalid call at import(t.toString()), with processing-fps 0.0. No real camera/face data was available for validation because the bundle fails first.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: open preview, click Iniciar Demonstração, wait ~1.5s. Expo Metro attempts to transform node_modules/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/vision_bundle.mjs and rejects its internal dynamic import(t.toString()). RealFaceEngine.web imports the package dynamically, but Metro still resolves/transforms the package and fails before createFromOptions/detectForVideo can execute.
